name: notyours
description: Prove your users' data stays theirs: cross-user leak tests for your own app, driven by Kane CLI personas and a canary-token oracle

scripts.test:unit: vitest run --exclude src/engine/__tests__/engine.test.ts --exclude src/engine/__tests__/chrome.test.ts --exclude src/engine/__tests__/session.test.ts --exclude src/engine/__tests__/wipe.test.ts --exclude src/cli/cli.test.ts
scripts.test:browser: vitest run --no-file-parallelism src/engine/__tests__/engine.test.ts src/engine/__tests__/chrome.test.ts src/engine/__tests__/session.test.ts src/engine/__tests__/wipe.test.ts src/cli/cli.test.ts
scripts.test:false-green: vitest run src/engine/__tests__/false-green.test.ts src/engine/__tests__/oracle.test.ts src/hooks/stop.test.ts src/hooks/app-freshness.test.ts src/ratchet/ratchet.test.ts && vitest run src/cli/cli.test.ts -t "daily authoring budget|credits and exit codes"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build
